mapper.sql: p.prj_id,p.prj_no,p.prj_nm,p.cntrct_ty_cd,p.prj_stts_cd,p.bsn_part_id,b.bsn_part_nm AS part_name, coalesce(d.dev_nm,'PM 미지정') AS owner,p.init_cntrct_amt,p.cur_cntrct_amt,p.trgt_cst_amt,p.trgt_mrgn_rt, (SELECT sum(s.need_mm_qty) FROM prj.psn_plan s WHERE s.prj_id=p.prj_id AND s.plan_ym BETWEEN #{from} AND #{month}) AS plan_mm_qty, CASE WHEN tk_remaining.row_count>0 THEN tk_remaining.mm ELSE (SELECT sum(s.need_mm_qty) FROM prj.psn_plan s WHERE s.prj_id=p.prj_id AND s.plan_ym > #{month}) END AS remaining_mm_qty, CASE WHEN tk_remaining.row_count>0 THEN tk_remaining.amount ELSE (SELECT CASE WHEN bool_or(s.expc_mth_cst_amt IS NULL) THEN NULL ELSE sum(s.need_mm_qty*s.expc_mth_cst_amt) END FROM prj.psn_plan s WHERE s.prj_id=p.prj_id AND s.plan_ym > #{month}) END AS remaining_cost_amt, (SELECT w.actl_prgs_rt FROM prj.wkly_memo w WHERE w.prj_id=p.prj_id AND w.wrt_dt < to_date(#{month},'YYYY-MM')+interval '1 month' ORDER BY w.wrt_dt DESC,w.memo_id DESC LIMIT 1) AS actl_prgs_rt, (SELECT count(DISTINCT a.dev_id) FROM asgn.asgn a WHERE a.prj_id=p.prj_id AND a.asgn_stts_cd!='CANCELLED' AND a.bgn_dt < to_date(#{month},'YYYY-MM')+interval '1 month' AND a.end_dt >= to_date(#{month},'YYYY-MM')) AS headcount

FROM prj.prj p LEFT JOIN mst.bsn_part b ON b.bsn_part_id=p.bsn_part_id LEFT JOIN mst.dev d ON d.dev_id=p.pm_dev_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT count(*) AS row_count,sum(t.mm_qty) AS mm, CASE WHEN bool_or(t.mm_qty IS NULL OR salary.indv_lbr_cst_amt IS NULL) THEN NULL ELSE sum(t.mm_qty*salary.indv_lbr_cst_amt) END AS amount FROM prj.tk_aloc_line l JOIN prj.tk_aloc_mth t ON t.aloc_line_id=l.aloc_line_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT s.indv_lbr_cst_amt FROM cst.mth_cst s WHERE s.dev_id=l.dev_id AND s.cst_ym <= #{month} ORDER BY s.cst_ym DESC LIMIT 1) salary ON true WHERE l.prj_id=p.prj_id AND l.line_ty_cd='PERSON' AND t.aloc_ym > #{month} AND l.aloc_stg_cd=(SELECT x.aloc_stg_cd FROM prj.tk_aloc_line x WHERE x.prj_id=p.prj_id ORDER BY CASE x.aloc_stg_cd WHEN 'ACTUAL' THEN 0 WHEN 'FINAL' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END LIMIT 1) ) tk_remaining ON true
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT d.dev_id,d.dev_nm FROM mst.dev d JOIN asgn.asgn a ON a.dev_id=d.dev_id WHERE a.prj_id=#{id} ORDER BY d.dev_id
SELECT num_val FROM cmn.oprt_std WHERE oprt_std_id='RENEGO_COST_RATIO' AND aply_bgn_ym <= #{month} ORDER BY aply_bgn_ym DESC LIMIT 1
